    // The next corner counter-clockwise around the same triangle, wrapping from
    // slot 2 back to slot 0.
    NextCorner(corner: CornerIndex): CornerIndex
        => CornerIndex(corner.Value - corner.Value % 3 + (corner.Value + 1) % 3);
